name: database
description:
Consultas, análisis, exportación CSV/JSON y administración de bases de datos (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL).
Acciones y argumentos (usar en args): analyze_database { database } | backup_database { database, destination } | create_database { database } | delete_database { database } | describe { database, table } | describe_table { database, table } | execute_query { engine, database, query, user, password, host } | execute_script { engine, database, scriptFile } | explain_query { database, query } | export_table { database, table, format, destination } | import_table { database, table, data, source } | list_tables { database } | query { engine, database, query, user, password, host } | restore_database { database, source } | schema { database, table } | script { engine, database, scriptFile } | search_tables { database } | show_tables { database } | tables { database }
